rejected_csv_channel: fredgraph-<CODE>.csv are kept ONLY as rejection evidence: per csv-decimal-mismatches.json (docs/superpowers/handoff/evidence/task-14-fred/), 10 of 12 series show nonzero exact Decimal differences vs the API observations (binary float tails such as 70.51 vs 70.51000000000001 for POILBREUSDM 2006-05). The working independent verifier channel is the server-rendered data-table HTML: all 417 numeric API values per series match the table exactly (table-comparison.json in the preflight archive).
